name: City breaks
title: City breaks
intro: Museums, markets, parks and a good place for lunch. Here's where to go for a city break, how long to stay and the best months to visit.

faqs.question: Where is good for a weekend city break?
faqs.answer: Places like Amsterdam, Paris, Prague, Porto, Vienna and Kraków are short flights from the UK and easy to see in two or three nights.

faqs.question: When is the best time for a city break?
faqs.answer: Spring and autumn suit most cities in Europe and North America: it's warm enough to walk all day without the summer crowds. Each guide shows its best months.

faqs.question: Where can we go for a city break in winter sun?
faqs.answer: Dubai, Bangkok, Penang, Cape Town and Miami are all at their best between December and February.
